in_arabic.name: آيلا
in_arabic.long_meaning: آيلا هو اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر العربي أَلأَ الذي يعني الضياء والنور، ولهذا الاسم أهمية دينية وثقافية في التراث الإسلامي حيث يرمز إلى النور الإلهي والهداية في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: ایلاء
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے نور اور روشنی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایلاء ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو عربی gốc سے لیا گیا ہے، اس نام کی اہمیت مسلم ثقافت میں بہت ہے کیونکہ یہ نور اور روشنی کی علامت ہے جو کہ قرآن پاک میں بھی ذکر ہے

in_hindi.name: अयला
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है प्रकाश और ज्योति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अयला एक इस्लामिक नाम है जो अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, इस नाम का महत्व भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में बहुत है क्योंकि यह प्रकाश और ज्योति का प्रतीक है जो कुरान में भी उल्लेखित है

in_pashto.name: ایلا

data.cultural_impact: The name Aylaa holds a rich cultural significance in the Islamic tradition, originating from the Arabic language. In Middle Eastern and Islamic societies, naming a child holds great importance, often reflecting cherished family values, beliefs, and social practices. The name Aylaa evokes images of the night sky and the tranquility it brings, which could be associated with the comforting presence of Allah or a deep understanding of the natural world. This name is also reminiscent of night prayers and night journeys, which are considered auspicious in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aylaa also carries deep spiritual significance rooted in Islamic belief. The Arabic word "aylah" means "night." Aylaa's name exudes the idea of a soul that journeys in the night of this transient world, finding solace in the Almighty Allah. This name resonates with tasawwuf, the Sufi path of spiritual growth, emphasizing self-discipline, striving for purity of heart, and seeking direct experience of God. Aylaa, as a night gazer, may be encouraged to establish a powerful connection with Allah through consistent prayer and meditation during the night, as this is a time when worldly distractions may be at their least.
